text: ZX Bank is committed to providing comprehensive and accessible financial services across Bangalore, one of India’s most dynamic metropolitan cities. With a robust branch network distributed throughout North, South, East, West, and Central Bangalore, customers enjoy seamless banking solutions close to their neighborhoods. The branches are strategically located to cater to residential, commercial, and emerging tech districts, ensuring a convenient banking experience for every customer.
